retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast 1980s graphic style featuring a vertical white column with falling 3D geometric blocks against a vibrant blue background, bisected by a jagged red diagonal stroke.

recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant blue composition featuring a vertical white ruled column on the left. Floating, black 3D rectangular blocks (resembling piano keys) are scattered along the column. A thick, jagged red diagonal line cuts across the center, overlaid with expressive red script and clean, technical sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical white column acts as a structural anchor for falling black blocks
Diagonal red stroke creates dynamic tension against the vertical column
Handwritten script contrasts with the rigid geometric sans-serif text
3D blocks provide depth against the flat, textured blue background
coreInvariants: Black 3D blocks with grey drop shadows
Jagged, airbrushed edge on the red diagonal element
Thin horizontal lines within the white vertical column

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The vertical column occupies the left third; the red diagonal and text occupy the central and right quadrants.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The thick red diagonal stroke serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes follow the vertical column downward with the falling blocks, then are pulled across the frame by the red diagonal stroke to the text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large areas of blue background provide breathing room for the busy geometric and typographic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cerulean blue background providing high-energy contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the vertical column and secondary text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for the diagonal stroke and primary script.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across primary colors with black and white used for structural definition.

letterConstructionRules: Primary script is slanted at a 30-degree angle with a textured, airbrushed outline
Secondary text uses ultra-condensed, high-waisted geometric forms
Tertiary text is enclosed in parentheses with wide tracking
characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand is simplified into a single fluid stroke
The 'O' and 'R' in the condensed font have extremely tight apertures
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, slanted script paired with rigid, vertical condensed sans-serif for a 'tech-meets-art' 80s feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-condensed, high-waisted verticality of the subtitle.
Captures the energetic, slanted hand-drawn feel of the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cerulean blue background with a vertical white column on the left containing thin horizontal black lines. Add scattered black 3D rectangular blocks with grey shadows falling along the column. Include a thick, jagged red diagonal stroke across the center with a grainy, airbrushed edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a red slanted script above the diagonal stroke and a black ultra-condensed sans-serif title below it. Ensure the script has a slightly textured outline.

verificationChecks: Is the background a vibrant cerulean blue?
Are the black blocks rendered with 3D depth and shadows?
Does the red diagonal have a jagged, spray-painted edge?
Is the subtitle font extremely narrow and tall?

mustRedesign: Avoid exact replication of specific brand logos
Ensure script is a generic expressive style

mustAchieve: High contrast between red, blue, and white
Clean geometric execution of the column and blocks
Grainy texture on the red stroke

postGenerationChecks: Check that the 3D blocks appear to be falling or floating.
Verify the red script is legible despite the slant.
Ensure the white column is perfectly vertical.
Confirm the halftone/grainy texture is visible on the red elements.
recipe.reuseFormula: 80s Pop Geometry = (Cerulean Background + Vertical Ruled Column) * (Falling 3D Blocks) + (Jagged Airbrush Diagonal) / (Condensed Sans + Slanted Script)
